dict.string: Immich Sync uploads photos and videos from the source folders you add, including folders on your Desktop.
Immich Sync uploads photos and videos from the source folders you add, including folders in your Documents folder.
Immich Sync uploads photos and videos from the source folders you add, including folders in your Downloads folder.
Immich Sync uploads photos and videos from the source folders you add on mounted network volumes.
Immich Sync uploads photos and videos from the source folders you add on removable volumes such as SD cards and USB drives.
